messages:
oliver: FYI: planned controlled failover & kernel microcode update in us-west-1. Window: Sat 2025-01-11 23:00-01:00 UTC. Expect brief p95 latency bumps during AZ switch.

maria: We'll do staggered AZ drains (5-10m per AZ), kv-cache prewarm after switch. No expected full outage. Relax p95 SLO from 300ms->700ms for the window to suppress paging. Filing INC-2025-101.

tim: Will reduce background job concurrency and hold a preflight synthetic at Fri 22:00 UTC to validate routing.

oliver: Primary oncall: @maria; backup: @tim. Abort criteria: error rate >6% for 10m or 25% request latency increase sustained >15m.

sre-bot: Canary deploy started to 3 nodes in us-west-1 1:15 UTC 1 build-2102. CI: https://ci.redwood/2102

maria: Customer-facing note not required; internal support blurb posted to INC. Runbook: https://go/redwood/runbooks/region-maint

oliver: Thanks all, will publish the brief in #general after final check.
